args.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and this fallback is being hit in production, causing password reset (and other) emails to link to localhost instead of the real site. Ensure PUBLIC_URL (or an equivalent production config value, e.g. config.app.baseUrl) is reliably set and read in the deployed environment so BASE_URL resolves to the correct public URL, and consider removing or guarding the localhost fallback so a missing environment variable fails loudly instead of silently producing broken links in production.
